Background memory patrol now rechecks itself on every summary round: the derived project overview is rebuilt from current sources, and procedure experience past its expiry date is retired so stale know-how stops being recalled.

## What changed since 0.4.52

- Each summary round triggers an incremental review: the derived project overview is rebuilt from the current memory sources (your hand-written notes are never overwritten), and expired provisional/validated procedure experience is moved to deprecated. Expired procedures no longer pass the recall gate, so answers stop leaning on out-of-date know-how.

- Carries all 0.4.50/0.4.51/0.4.52 features: reply-enhancement horse-head entry (font color off / bottom-up theme ripple generating / solid theme ready, same with evolution on or off), idle-hiding chat scrollbar, at-most-two silent language corrections across main chat, group orchestration, subagents and visible summaries, background memory (progressive recall, recall traces, virtual directory, derived overview, confirmed same-source correction tombstones), explicit host-boundary scope enforcement with read-only legacy backfill, stable immutable project IDs, and the Pondsi Attribution License.

## Honest boundaries

- Expiry review only retires procedures that carry an explicit expiry date; undated experience keeps its existing lifecycle and still needs host verification or your review to become validated.

- Language detection is heuristic; short or uncertain text is left alone. Derived memory is not the original record; corrections require evidence and never rewrite chat originals. Model output and generated files still need review. Permissions remain per session; no self-improvement can disable the safety boundaries.

## Install

Download WArmy-Setup-0.4.53.exe from this release and run it. Existing WArmyData carries over. The installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. The installer SHA-256 is listed in the Checksum section below. First run stops at the language page and waits for you.
